finding: The single Categoria column mixes five incompatible semantic axes
evidence: Of 22 category values: 8 are subcellular localisation (114 terms), 3 are taxonomic domain (19 terms), 2 are cell type (22 terms), 2 are biological process, 1 is disease state, 1 is evidence type, 1 is structural association, 3 are explicit hybrids ('Viral/Nuclear', 'Nuclear/Mitótico', 'Nuclear/Citoplasmático')
biological_impact: A term cannot be simultaneously classified: p_granule is germline AND cytoplasmic AND RNA-metabolic, but the schema forces one. Any query of the form 'all nuclear MLOs' silently misses the 22 cell-type-labelled and 19 taxon-labelled terms, most of which do have a defined localisation
recommended_action: Replace with five orthogonal columns: compartment_class (single-valued, spatial only), taxonomic_scope, cell_type_context, functional_process (multi-valued), physiological_state

finding: Citoplasma and Citoplasmático are the same category under two spellings
evidence: 5 terms carry Citoplasma, 39 carry Citoplasmático; six canonicals (stress_granule, necrosome, p62_body, sirna_body, ubqln_puncta, cytoplasmic_rnp_granule) receive both across their source names
biological_impact: Splits the largest localisation class in two and makes conflict counts look like curation disagreements when they are spelling variants
recommended_action: Merge to one value at ingestion; this alone resolves 6 of the 24 reported category conflicts

finding: Taxonomic categories are assigned by curator judgement and two are contradicted by the data
evidence: refractile_body is labelled Procariota but its only protein is from Eimeria tenella, an apicomplexan protist; rho_body is labelled Procariota with no organism-resolvable annotation. Conversely aggresome (100% E. coli), sirna_body, nuclear_dicing_body, antiviral_condensate and plant_signaling_condensate (100% plant) carry localisation categories instead
biological_impact: The taxonomic axis is unreliable for filtering, which matters because prokaryotic and plant condensates are exactly the subsets a user would want to isolate
recommended_action: Derive taxonomic_scope from the annotated organisms and store the supporting fraction; use curator override only where data are absent

finding: 24 canonicals receive conflicting categories from their source names, and the conflict is not resolved anywhere in the served schema
evidence: signaling_condensate alone receives 5 different categories (Citoplasmático, Membrana, Mitocondrial, Nuclear, Nuclear/Procariota); replication_compartment receives 3 spellings of the same viral/nuclear hybrid
biological_impact: The conflicts are symptoms of CAT-01: a signalosome genuinely is membrane-proximal, cytoplasmic and sometimes nuclear, and the schema has no way to say so
recommended_action: The multi-axis schema removes 18 of the 24 conflicts by construction; the remaining 6 are genuine curation decisions to be recorded

finding: 'In vitro' as a category places an evidence type in a spatial vocabulary
evidence: in_vitro_droplet is the only member of category 'In vitro'; 99.2% of its assertions are driver and 142 of its 426 proteins have no in-vivo MLO
biological_impact: Users filtering by localisation see a category that is not a location; users filtering for in-vivo evidence have no way to exclude reconstituted droplets from other terms
recommended_action: Move to physiological_state='engineered' plus an evidence_type field on the annotation

finding: Citoesqueleto is a structural association, not a compartment
evidence: 6 terms (centrosome, contractile_ring, actin_cortical_patch, spindle_apparatus, +2); all are cytosolic condensates nucleated on or by cytoskeletal elements
biological_impact: Cytoskeleton-associated condensates are excluded from cytosolic queries although they are cytosolic
recommended_action: compartment_class='cytosol' plus functional_process='cell_division'/'cell_polarity' and an optional scaffold_association field

finding: Two singleton categories exist for one term each
evidence: 'Secretor', 'Autofagia', 'Mitótico', 'Unspecified' and 'In vitro' each label exactly one term
biological_impact: Singleton categories add schema surface without discriminating power
recommended_action: Absorb into the proposed axes as shown in category_axis_remap.csv
